home.title: Mission Days
home.empty: You are not an organiser of any Mission Day yet.
home.slug: Web address of the Mission Day
home.slugHelp: The last part of the Mission Day's public URL and of the proposal links sent to partners. It is proposed from the city and the year. Only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot be changed after creation, so that links already sent never break.
home.ownerHelp: Leave empty to be the owner yourself.
settings.myMapsUrl: Map link (My Maps or a picture)
letterDefaults.title: Default letter texts
letterDefaults.help: Every new Mission Day copies these texts and can then adapt them. Changing them here does not modify Mission Days already created.
settings.letterHelp: Common to the proposals for every partner. They were copied from the default texts when the Mission Day was created, and you can adapt them here.
settings.dangerHelp: Removes its missions, portals and photos for good.
missions.title: Candidate missions
mission.photoHelp: Drag the image to frame it and use the slider to zoom. By default it takes the largest centred square. Missions use a 512 × 512 px copy; a high-quality one (up to 2048 px) is also kept for printing Biocards.
mission.photoLoadError: That file could not be opened as an image.
mission.photoSmallOnly: This photo is only stored at 512 px because it was uploaded before high-quality copies were kept. Upload it again and the Biocards will print sharper.
mission.photoFull: Also stored in high quality ({size} × {size} px) for the Biocards.
mission.routeHelp: Click the map to add a portal, or paste coordinates or an Intel link below.
mission.invalidCoordinates: Those coordinates could not be understood.
map.title: Map of the missions
selection.title: Final selection
selection.selectedHelp: Drag to reorder. The order is only a suggestion for agents.
selection.emptySelected: Drag missions here or use the + button.
selection.mosaicHelp: As agents see it in the scanner: the first mission is at the bottom right.
selection.allGood: The selection meets every rule the tool checks.
selection.bannerWarning: “{first}” and “{second}” have very similar edges and could read as one picture.
issue.mission.landmarkMissing: The landmark or theme is missing.
issue.mission.nameTooLong: The full name has {length} characters; the limit is {max}.
issue.mission.descriptionTooLong: The description in {language} has {length} characters; the limit is {max}.
issue.mission.sequenceHint: The text seems to point to another mission. Missions must stand alone.
issue.mission.tooFewWaypoints: It has {count} portals; the minimum is {min}.
issue.mission.tooManyWaypoints: It has {count} portals; the maximum is {max}.
issue.selection.wrongCount: {count} missions are selected; this format needs {expected}.
issue.selection.orderInvalid: The recommended order has gaps or repeats.
issue.selection.sharedPortal: It shares a portal with another selected mission.
error.invalid_file: That type of file is not accepted.
error.invalid_overlay: The overlay must be a 512×512 PNG with transparency.
partners.title: Partners
partner.name: Name
partner.overlayHelp: 512×512 PNG, transparent where the photo must show, prepared from the official Mission Day template.
partner.approvalHelp: PDF or image with the written permission to use the logo.
partner.proposalHelp: Anyone with this link can see the proposal, so send it only to this entity. It uses the saved language of the letter.
partner.confirmRegenerate: Click again: the current link will stop working
partner.previewHelp: The selected missions with this partner's overlay, or the default one if it has none.
settings.placeholdersHelp: You can write {partner} and {city}: in the proposal they are replaced by the names of the partner and the city.
settings.defaultOverlayHelp: 512×512 PNG with transparency, used when a partner has no overlay of its own.
settings.mapScreenshotHelp: Image of the map shown in the proposals and used when printing them.
proposal.invalid: This link is not valid or is no longer available.
proposal.title: Mission Day {city} {year}
proposal.whyYou: Why we are writing to you
proposal.mosaicHelp: The images show the logo applied as an example.
proposal.consentText: {partner} authorises Ingress (Niantic Spatial, Inc.) to use its logo and, where applicable, its photographs in the mission images within the application, for Mission Day {city} {year}, under the conditions described in this document.
partner.inheritedTextHelp: Copied from the Mission Day's texts when the partner was created. Changes here affect only this partner. It is shown in the language of the letter.
error.invalid_selection: Some missions no longer exist. Reload the page.
settings.applicationThemeHelp: One of the answers of the Niantic application form.
exports.title: Exports
exports.partnerHelp: Without a partner, the default overlay is used.
exports.languageHelp: Unless it is English, the English text is added too, but only if it fits in every mission.
exports.ummMatTitle: UMM file for the authoring tool
exports.ummMatHelp: The selected missions in recommended order, to pre-fill the Mission Authoring Tool.
exports.ummAllTitle: UMM file to edit in IITC
exports.ummAllHelp: All the candidates, to draw or fix their routes in IITC.
exports.imagesHelp: The 512×512 PNG of every selected mission, numbered in order.
exports.csvHelp: Names, descriptions, and each portal with its coordinates and Intel link.
exports.kmlHelp: One layer of portals and one of routes, to import by hand.
exports.kmlGuideTitle: How to create the My Maps
exports.kmlGuideStep1: Open Google My Maps with your account and create a new map.
exports.kmlGuideStep2: Click the map title and give it the name of the Mission Day.
exports.kmlGuideStep3: In the layer on the left panel, click Import and upload the .kml file downloaded from here.
exports.kmlGuideStep4: Click Share and turn on link access, so that anyone with the link can view the map but not edit it.
exports.kmlGuideStep5: Copy the link and paste it in Settings, in the Map link field.
exports.importHelp: Import the latest file exported for editing in IITC. Only the portals are taken from the file. Names and descriptions stay as they are here. You will see the changes before anything is saved.
exports.importError.invalid_file: That file could not be read as a UMM file.
exports.importError.unsupported_version: This file was made with an older version of UMM. Export it again with a current version.
exports.importOutOfRange: It would have {count} portals, outside the allowed range.
exports.importObjectives: {count} portals have an objective other than hacking.
exports.applicationHelp: The answers of the Niantic form, ready to copy and in English, like the form. Only the partner shown in the picture for the application is mentioned; with the default overlay, none is.
issue.mission.portalWithoutGuid: It has portals added by hand. Go through IITC with UMM to identify them.
issue.images.noOverlay: There is no overlay: upload the default one in Settings or choose a partner.
issue.partner.noApproval: The signed approval of this partner is missing.
issue.partner.notAccepted: This partner has not been marked as accepted.
issue.application.enlPocMissing: Details of the Enlightened Point of Contact are missing: codename, email, primary and backup contact.
issue.application.resPocMissing: Details of the Resistance Point of Contact are missing: codename, email, primary and backup contact.
issue.application.themeMissing: The theme of the Mission Day is missing.
error.partner_not_approved: This partner has not given its signed permission.
settings.differenceHelp: Only if a Mission Day was held in this area in the last two years.
exports.sampleHelp: Niantic asks for a link to a single picture of the logo/medal. This generates it from the first mission and the partner chosen above, and publishes it at a fixed address. Generate it again if the photo or the overlay change.
issue.application.sampleMissing: The picture for the application has not been generated.
issue.sample.firstPhotoMissing: The first selected mission has no photo.
team.title: Organisers of this Mission Day
team.help: People who can open this Mission Day in this tool. Owners can also manage this list and delete things; editors can change everything else. This is not the team written in Settings, which is what the application to Niantic lists.
team.lastOwnerHelp: A Mission Day always keeps at least one owner. To change the only owner, make someone else an owner first.
team.addHelp: Use the email they will sign in with. They receive no message from this tool: send them the address of the admin area, where they sign in with a code that arrives at that email.
team.outsider: You are not on this team, but as instance administrator you can manage it. Add yourself to open the rest of the Mission Day.
profile.title: My profile
profile.help: You are signed in as {email}. Your codename and faction are shown to the other organisers of your Mission Days.
profile.devHelp: Act as another organiser to try what each role sees. This block does not exist in the published tool.
home.othersTitle: Other Mission Days of the instance
home.othersHelp: You are not on their teams. As instance administrator you can manage their organisers.
settings.teamHelp: What the application to Niantic lists. Who can open this Mission Day in the tool is managed in Organisers.
error.already_member: That person is already on the team.
error.last_owner: A Mission Day must keep at least one owner.
participant.title: Mission Day {city} {year}
participant.intro: {missions} missions to discover the city. Complete at least {medal} of them on the day of the event to earn the medal.
participant.orderNote: The missions can be done in any order; the one below is only a suggestion.
participant.empty: The missions have not been chosen yet.
participantSettings.title: Participant view
participantSettings.help: A public page with the selected missions, their map and their portals, for agents to play. It is hidden from search engines: share its address wherever you choose.
participantSettings.partnerHelp: Only partners that have accepted, with their signed permission and an overlay, can be chosen.
participantSettings.notApproved: The page is published, but the Mission Day is not marked as approved by Niantic yet.
participantSettings.partnerLapsed: The chosen partner no longer has a valid permission or overlay, so the page shows the default overlay.
error.partner_without_overlay: That partner has no overlay yet.
site.tagline: A community-made tool to plan Ingress Mission Days, from the first idea to the day of the event.
site.whatBody: A Mission Day is an Ingress event where agents of both factions explore a city by following a set of missions designed to show its most interesting places. Completing at least {medal} of them on the day of the event earns a medal.
site.feature.missions: Plan the candidate missions, with their portals and routes.
site.feature.partners: Prepare a proposal for each partner organisation and ask for permission to use its logo.
site.feature.images: Compose the mission images and check the rules of the official Mission Day handbook.
site.feature.exports: Generate the files for the Niantic application and for creating the missions.
site.feature.participants: Publish the page agents use on the day of the event.
site.noMissionDays: No Mission Day has been published yet.
site.unavailable: The Mission Days cannot be loaded right now.
site.useTitle: Would you like to use it?
site.useBody: If you organise a Mission Day and would like to use this tool, ask whoever runs it:
site.disclaimer: Unofficial community tool. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Niantic Spatial.
instance.title: Instance settings
instance.help: Options that affect the whole instance. The public home page shows the Mission Days whose participant view is published, and this contact.
instance.contactHelp: Shown on the home page so that people can ask to use the tool. The page is public and shows up in search engines. Leave both fields empty to hide it.
instance.contactLabelHelp: For example @codename. If empty, the link itself is shown.
instance.contactUrlHelp: An https:// address (such as https://t.me/codename) or a mailto: one (such as mailto:someone@example.org). If empty, the text is shown without a link.
error.invalid_contact_label: The contact text is too long.
error.invalid_contact_url: The contact link must start with https://, http:// or mailto:.
settings.participantIntroHelp: Replaces the default sentence of the participant page ("{missions} missions to discover the city. Complete at least {medal}…"), shown under the title and date. Each visitor sees the text of their language; where you leave it empty, they see the default sentence in that language. You can write {missions}, replaced by the number of selected missions, and {medal}, replaced by the minimum number of missions that earns the medal.
error.invalid_participant_intro: The presentation for agents is too long.
partner.biocardAnswerHelp: What the partner answered: whether it wants to appear on the Biocards, and whether it would like a card of its own.
biocardAnswer.own: Agrees, and wants a card of its own
proposal.consentBiocards: We agree to appear on the Biocards of the Mission Day.
proposal.consentOwnBiocard: We would like a Biocard of our own.
biocard.title: Biocards
biocard.intro: Cards to remember the Mission Day: one for the Mission Day as a whole and one for any mission you choose. The templates are made outside the tool, with the city and any partner logo already on them; here you only place the photo, the name and the description.
biocard.frontHelp: PNG transparent where the photo must show, usually a square at the top. Its size sets the print size: a card is 63 × 88 mm, plus the cut margin your printer asks for on each side.
biocard.backHelp: PNG or JPEG of the same size as the front.
biocard.fontHelp: Optional: a TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2 file you are allowed to use. Without it, cards use Coda, a free font in the style of the game.
biocard.fontOwn: Using the font of this Mission Day.
biocard.fontRemove: Go back to the default font
biocard.templatesUnreadable: The templates could not be read. Upload them again.
biocard.geometry: {width} × {height} px: {widthMm} × {heightMm} mm without cut margin, {dpi} dpi.
biocard.geometryBleed: {width} × {height} px: {widthMm} × {heightMm} mm with a cut margin of {bleed} mm per side, {dpi} dpi.
biocard.warning.frontProportions: The front does not have the proportions of a 63 × 88 mm card, with or without a cut margin.
biocard.warning.backProportions: The back does not have the proportions of a 63 × 88 mm card, with or without a cut margin.
biocard.warning.sizesDiffer: Front and back have different sizes.
biocard.warning.noWindow: The front has no transparent part, so the photo will not show.
biocard.warning.windowNotTop: The transparent part of the front is not at the top.
biocard.warning.windowNotSquare: The transparent part of the front is not square, so photos will be cropped to fit it.
biocard.warning.lowResolution: The templates print at {dpi} dpi; 300 dpi gives sharper cards.
biocard.warning.lowPhotoResolution: {count} of the chosen cards have a photo that would print below 250 dpi (the lowest at about {dpi} dpi) and may look soft. They are marked in the list of cards: upload their photo again in the mission's page, at a higher resolution if possible.
biocard.layoutHelp: Drag each box to move it and its corner to resize it, or type the figures in millimetres from the top-left corner of the template. Texts shrink by themselves when they do not fit. The dashed red line shows where the card will be cut.
biocard.needTemplates: Upload both templates to place the texts.
biocard.textOverflows: The text does not fit in its box even at the smallest size.
biocard.genericHelp: A card for the Mission Day as a whole, made on its own or together with those of the missions. To show it on the pages, tick it in the list of cards.
biocard.genericNameHelp: Leave it empty if the template already says it all.
biocard.genericPhoto.collage: A collage of the photos of the selected missions
biocard.photoHelp: PNG, JPEG or WebP you are allowed to use. It is cropped around its centre to fill the transparent part of the front.
biocard.collageHelp: The collage uses the photos of the {count} selected missions that have one, in recommended order.
biocard.showOnProposals: Show the ticked cards in the partner proposals
biocard.showOnParticipantView: Show the ticked cards in the participant view
biocard.showHelp: Only ticked cards that have a picture are shown, and of the missions only those in the selection. If the template carries a partner logo, every partner who opens a proposal will see it: show them there only once that partner agrees. The ticks and these two boxes are saved by themselves.
biocard.cardsHelp: Tick the cards to generate and show. Next to each mission you can write a shorter name for its card; when empty, the landmark is used.
biocard.notSelected: Not selected: not shown on the pages
biocard.languageHelp: When a description is missing in this language, English or another available one is used.
biocard.overflowingCards: These cards have a text that does not fit even at the smallest size: {cards}.
biocard.generateUnsaved: Cards are drawn with the changes on screen, saved or not.
error.invalid_biocard_front: The front must be a PNG with transparency, at most 5000 px per side.
error.invalid_font: The font must be a TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2 file of at most 2 MB.
error.invalid_biocard: Some Biocard setting is not valid.
error.invalid_biocard_name: The name on the card is too long.
error.invalid_biocard_answer: Choose a valid answer about the Biocards.
